current_concerns.primary_problems: Waves of sadness and missing his wife, who died of cancer about a year ago; tears around anniversaries and similar reminders. Still working, sleeping reasonably, and seeing friends.
current_concerns.goals: Learn how to live with the loss and keep going the way his wife would have wanted.

past_psychiatric_history.previous_therapies: Bereavement group through hospice services in 2025, approximately 8 sessions.
past_psychiatric_history.previous_treatments: No other previous mental-health treatments besides the bereavement group.

substance_use.nonmedical_alcohol_use: Beer, mostly on weekends, about two; has been drinking this way for around 40 years.

education_employment_legal_history.employment_history: Currently working as a civil engineer at Marchmont Consulting; employed there since 1991.

personal_history.early_childhood: Born in Cork and moved to Toronto at age 8. Described childhood as warm, with no significant difficulties standing out.
personal_history.adolescence_early_adulthood: Completed an engineering degree; no significant difficulties reported.
personal_history.significant_relationships: Married to his wife for 33 years; she died of cancer about a year ago. He is widowed and has two adult children nearby who provide support.
personal_history.future_goals: Keep working, see his grandchildren, and travel a little.
